events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Mitchell's (CLE) pass deflects off of Mobley's (CLE) hands and goes out of bounds.
Mitchell (CLE) firms up in a position in Adebayo's (MIA) path and the ensuing contact between the two players is marginal.
Mobley (CLE) legally contests Rozier's (MIA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Mitchell (CLE) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Rozier (MIA).
Although Highsmith (MIA) makes contact to the ball, he also makes illegal contact to Strus's (CLE) wrist that pulls his hand away from the ball.
Adebayo (MIA) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Hunter's (CLE) floater attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Garland's (CLE) pass deflects off of Hunter's (CLE) hands and goes out of bounds.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Adebayo (MIA) loses control of the ball and it goes out of bounds.
Anderson (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Mitchell (CLE) and any ensuing contact to the arm is incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Anderson (MIA) deflects the ball off of Mitchell (CLE), who is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Robinson (MIA) steps out of bounds prior to entering his shooting motion.
Mitchell (MIA) attempts to go for the steal and initiates contact with Garland's (CLE) arm, affecting Garland's SQBR.
